start.content: When we sat on the Mount of Olives, He told us the Temple would fall stone from stone. I asked when these things would happen and what sign would mark His coming.

signs.content: He warned us about wars, famines, earthquakes, and false messiahs. He called them birth pains, not the end itself. The command was to endure and stay watchful.

impact.content: I expected quick victory, not a long road of tribulation. His words shifted us from timelines to faithfulness: keep awake, keep serving, keep trusting the Father.

choices.text: So readiness matters more than dates.

temple.content: Yes. The stones looked eternal from that hill, but He said they would collapse. The true warning was spiritual: do not be deceived, and do not lose heart.
